answer: Each extra identity costs one refundable 260 POA bond locked 70 days behind a single device key, so one bond cannot fund many identities or be aged in bulk. The bonded key is published as a violet credential in a public registry. Each month, randomly assigned auditors send a short live task through the nebula channel and check it against that registry entry. Sharing a key or trying to forge a second credential loses the whole bond and bars the agent.
